court_matters.value: The Public Protector investigated allegations of maladministration during Mashaba's term as mayor (irregular appointments, irregular salary increases, financial mismanagement, procurement irregularities and conflicts of interest) and made adverse findings against him, which he challenged in court.
court_matters.label: Disputed
court_matters.outcome: The High Court in Pretoria set the Public Protector's findings aside as unconstitutional, unlawful and invalid on 31 January 2023 (TimesLIVE, 2 February 2023; ActionSA statement, 31 January 2023). No appeal found in allowed sources as of 15 November 2026. Mashaba said the ruling vindicated him.
